# shadcn-nsh

Styled NSH component library (copy-into-app), analogous to shadcn/ui on Radix.

## Commands

- Create monorepo: `shadcn-nsh create <name>` → apps/web + packages/ui
- Init existing app: `shadcn-nsh init`
- Add component: `shadcn-nsh add <name>` (monorepo: `-c apps/web` writes packages/ui)
- Registry URL template: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aningdev/shadcn-nsh/main/public/r/{name}.json`

## Layout

- Authoring: packages/theme, packages/ui, packages/cli
- Gallery (native): apps/gallery
- Docs (web): apps/docs
- Consumer template: templates/nsh-monorepo

## Docs (this site)

Hybrid IA: this site covers install, usage, composition/examples, **this package’s** API, Differences (vs shadcn), and Not forwarded (vs `nsh/base`). Behavior, keyboard, a11y, platform notes, and full unstyled props → https://nsh.dev/elements (per-element pages). Do not treat this file as a fork of nsh `llms-full`.

Extensions / Phase-2 / base exports newer than store CLI → `packages/ui/COMPONENTS.md` (not listed as pages here).

Component pages may embed a web Preview (`demo:` → `nsh package --target web` iframe). Native behaviour truth remains the gallery (`apps/gallery`), not docs iframes. Demo sources: `apps/docs/demos/<slug>.tsx`.

- /docs/getting-started: Create a monorepo or init shadcn-nsh in an existing NSH app.
- /docs/theme: theme.json is token truth; token() / @shadcn-nsh/theme helpers.
- /docs/components: Phase-1 styled wrappers on store nsh/base (0.3.x).
- /docs/components/button: Styled button wrapping nsh/base Button. → https://nsh.dev/elements/button
- /docs/components/checkbox: Styled checkbox wrapping nsh/base Checkbox. → https://nsh.dev/elements/checkbox
- /docs/components/collapsible: Styled collapsible wrapping nsh/base Collapsible. → https://nsh.dev/elements/collapsible
- /docs/components/context-menu: Styled context menu wrapping nsh/base ContextMenu. → https://nsh.dev/elements/menu
- /docs/components/dialog: Styled dialog wrapping nsh/base Dialog. → https://nsh.dev/elements/dialog
- /docs/components/dropdown-menu: Styled menu wrapping nsh/base Menu — theme tokens + Trigger / Content / Item; full base prop pass-through. → https://nsh.dev/elements/menu
- /docs/components/input: Styled text input wrapping nsh/base Input. → https://nsh.dev/elements/input
- /docs/components/popover: Styled popover wrapping nsh/base Popover. → https://nsh.dev/elements/popover
- /docs/components/progress: Styled progress wrapping nsh/base Progress. → https://nsh.dev/elements/progress
- /docs/components/radio-group: Styled radio group wrapping nsh/base RadioGroup. → https://nsh.dev/elements/radio
- /docs/components/sheet: Styled sheet wrapping nsh/base Sheet. → https://nsh.dev/elements/sheet
- /docs/components/toast: Styled toast wrapping nsh/base Toast. → https://nsh.dev/elements/toast
- /docs/components/switch: Styled switch wrapping nsh/base Switch. → https://nsh.dev/elements/switch
- /docs/components/table: Styled table wrapping nsh/base Table. → https://nsh.dev/elements/table
- /docs/components/tabs: Styled tabs wrapping nsh/base Tabs. → https://nsh.dev/elements/tabs
- /docs/components/tooltip: Styled tooltip wrapping nsh/base Tooltip. → https://nsh.dev/elements/tooltip

Theme source of truth is theme.json (nsh.json `theme`), not CSS. Behavior details: https://nsh.dev/elements
